import json
parsed = json.loads(files)
entries = parsed["entries"]
# Build a tree-like view grouped by directory
from collections import defaultdict
dirs = defaultdict(list)
for e in entries:
    path = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = path.rsplit("/", 1)
    folder = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else "."
    name = parts[-1]
    size = e["size_bytes"]
    dirs[folder].append((name, size, e["is_dir"]))

output_lines = []
for folder in sorted(dirs.keys()):
    output_lines.append(f"\n📁 {folder}/")
    for name, size, is_dir in sorted(dirs[folder]):
        icon = "📂" if is_dir else "📄"
        size_str = f"{size:,} bytes" if not is_dir else ""
        output_lines.append(f"   {icon} {name}  {size_str}")

summary = f"Total files: {len(entries)}"
print(summary)
print("\n".join(output_lines))
